notes.title: Ice-Rink Heavyweight
notes.description: Three identical cream boxes glide on low-friction lanes, but their masses are approximately 3.994, 1.280 and 0.333 kg. Lift all three to identify the heaviest, then use the remaining probes to measure its sliding friction; an impulse of about 5.08 N·s sends it to 0.55 m.
notes.prompt: a low-friction ice-rink level: three identical boxes with very different masses, find the heaviest and land it just past half a metre
